messages:
morgan: Preflight failed on PR #482 — gitops preflight blocked the rollout. Policy 'thermal-gpu-buffer' triggered in eu-west-1: observed buffer below threshold. Screenshot uploaded: https://rwnd/secure/snap/PR482.jpg. Anyone seen mismatched cooling annotations between prod/staging?

deploy-bot: [automated] preflight check failed: policy=thermal-gpu-buffer, threshold=0.15, observed=0.08, action=block, rule_id=policy-therm-03

jia: Can you paste the node-level view? run: `kubectl get nodes -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,ACC:.metadata.labels.accelerator,GPU:.status.allocatable.nvidia.com/gpu,ANNO:.metadata.annotations.rack-thermal` and drop the output here.

morgan: here's a trimmed output from staging (just the gpu nodes):
```
ip-10-0-0-12  accelerator=nvidia  8  rack-thermal=hot
ip-10-0-0-13  accelerator=nvidia  8  rack-thermal=cooled
ip-10-0-0-14  accelerator=nvidia  8  rack-thermal=cooled
TOTAL allocatable.gpu=24
```
prod last week: TOTAL allocatable.gpu=32 on same region. Noticed `rack-thermal=hot` on one of the nodepool AZs.

aya: That smells like a nodepool machine-type / launch_template drift. Staging seems to have an older launch template (no coolant emulation). Can you check the TF module version + helm values overlay for the cluster? `terraform state show module.nodepool.aws_launch_template.template` and `git ls-tree origin/main clusters/eu-west-1/overlays/staging`

samir: On the generator side I flagged a helm values override last night: `gpu.coolantEnabled: false` got into the staging overlay via a CD patch. Could explain why one AZ is still on older instance type.

morgan: ran `helm get values infra-nodepool -n infra` from staging — snippet:
```
nodePool:
  node_type: g4dn.xlarge
  coolantEnabled: false
  desired_gpu_per_node: 8
```

aya: Confirmed. Root cause = helm overlay disabled coolant and Terraform not bumped, so staging launched smaller/legacy nodes. Options: 1) revert the staging overlay patch and re-run gitops (fast), 2) update TF/helm now and force a rolling replace (slower), 3) manual add temporary nodes from cooled pool and drain hot nodes (costly). I vote revert+reapply to keep parity.

samir: Cost note — moving staging to cooled GPUs (parity) ~+3.5k/mo, but avoids surprise SLO regressions for workload tests. Marking P1 for rollout parity.

infra-oncall: I can temporarily lift the preflight block for a 30m window if you need to push a canary while you revert overlay. Will create an audit ticket. Reply `+lift` to proceed.

morgan: Reverting the staging overlay PR now and will trigger gitops. Pushing fix in 2m. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [automated] preflight block lifted by infra-oncall for 30m — reason:"manual remediation in progress" audit=INC-2026-481

morgan: Follow-up: PR merged, gitops sync started, checking nodepool rollout logs. Will post when staging shows TOTAL allocatable.gpu=32. Thanks all.
